bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'RUNNING='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n"
printf 'IMAGE='; docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$n"
printf 'MENU_PATCH='; docker exec "$n" grep -c 'plain /start belongs to the common home menu' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs
printf 'POLL_READY='; docker logs --tail 500 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || true
printf 'GATE_READY='; docker logs --tail 500 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || true
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_CANDIDATES='
find "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot" -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname '*userbot*client*.py' -o -iname '*userbot*ipc*.py' -o -iname '*userbot*test*.py' \) -printf '%P ' 2>/dev/null || true
echo
